items.title: Derek Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: he got me and I was representing England, and he got a French pianist by the name of René Urtreger, and we all played like four tracks. And Dick Katz was there who was the American piano player.

ctx.x: Well what was the role with the, I mean, you were both piano players so what was he having—

He was making, it came out, the album was called “Jazz Piano International.” So he got me and I was representing England, and he got a French pianist by the name of René Urtreger, and we all played like four tracks. And Dick Katz was there who was the American piano player. And that’s how the album came out.

You know there’s been so many stories about these kinds of things where people, Al Grey who happened to be a club when the Basie band was there and their trombone player was sick and the guy said, “get your horn” and he ran, and it’s just little amazing coincidences that helped people.
